repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a one-shot wait followed by an infinite cycle of sending emails. The candidate incorrectly executes the cycle body (valve close + send mail) once immediately after the wait and then again in the `else` block on the first iteration of the 1-minute period, whereas the IR requires the valve close to happen only once and the email sending to repeat every minute indefinitely without re-closing the valve.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the immediate execution of the cycle body after the wait. Implemented the infinite cycle using a `period` of 60000 with a `phase` flag that triggers the email send only in the first iteration (phase 0) and subsequent iterations, while ensuring the valve is closed only once at the start.
